evidence_required: ranked hypotheses with tests, root cause, traffic-path explanation, fix, validation.

marking.criterion: Ranked hypotheses with tests: swapped cables (LLDP), optics/FEC (counters), GDR disabled (/GDRDMA), PCIe link degradation (LnkSta)
Root cause: rail 4/5 patch-panel swap on orion-n12 during the rack move
Traffic-path explanation: on an L2 rail VLAN the NIC still reaches peers; same-rail traffic crosses rails via the spines (or PXN), adding a hop and tail latency
Safe fix (drain at checkpoint, swap cords per plan) and validation (LLDP, mapping diff, nccl-tests, p99 over ≥ 5 runs)

title: One node slow after a rack move
